<style>
/* ===== Wadhwani Premium Compact Navigation Dropdown ===== */

/* Allow dropdown to overflow outside navigation */
.forceCommunityGlobalNavigation,
.comm-navigation,
.slds-context-bar,
.slds-context-bar__primary,
header,
nav {
    overflow: visible !important;
}

/* Parent trigger must anchor the dropdown */
.uiMenuTrigger,
.comm-navigation__item {
    position: relative !important;
}

/* Main dropdown container */
.uiMenuList.uiMenuList--default {
    background: #FFFFFF !important;
    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 10px !important;
    box-shadow:
        0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.06),
        0 12px 28px rgba(161,32,38,0.06) !important;

    min-width: 230px !important;
    padding: 4px 0 !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    z-index: 999999 !important;

    /* Proper dropdown positioning */
    position: absolute !important;
    top: calc(100% + 4px) !important;
    left: 0 !important;
    margin-top: 0 !important;
    transform: translateX(0) !important;

    /* Open animation */
    animation: fadeSlideIn 0.16s ease-out;
}

/* Menu rows */
.uiMenuList.uiMenuList--default .comm-navigation__menu-item,
.uiMenuList.uiMenuList--default .menuItem,
.uiMenuList.uiMenuList--default .uiMenuItem {
    background: #FFFFFF !important;
    transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #F5F5F5 !important;
}

/* Remove last divider */
.uiMenuList.uiMenuList--default .comm-navigation__menu-item:last-child,
.uiMenuList.uiMenuList--default .menuItem:last-child,
.uiMenuList.uiMenuList--default .uiMenuItem:last-child {
    border-bottom: none !important;
}

/* Links styling */
.uiMenuList.uiMenuList--default a {
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    padding: 11px 16px !important;
    font-size: 13px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    color: #2D3748 !important;
    background: #FFFFFF !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.15px !important;
    line-height: 1.3 !important;
}

/* Improved hover state */
.uiMenuList.uiMenuList--default a:hover {
    background: #FAFAFA !important;
    color: #A12026 !important;
    padding-left: 18px !important;
    border-left: 3px solid #A12026 !important;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(161,32,38,0.08) !important;
}

/* Active menu item */
.uiMenuList.uiMenuList--default .comm-navigation__menu-item.active a {
    background: #FAFAFA !important;
    color: #A12026 !important;
    border-left: 3px solid #A12026 !important;
}

/* Smooth open animation */
@keyframes fadeSlideIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(-6px);
    }
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}
</style>
label: main
